title: Two-tag Praxis with a refined four-direction stack lift
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5332 MiB (5.2068 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 85744 million field multiplications (14848 and 70896), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3, D, ell, Bsearch, T_tr, dec_sum_g1, search_spread, msis_bound) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
